Why Bulamu

Nutrition Guidance Should Feel Personal, Safe, and Practical.

I'm Breyer Naula, a Registered Dietitian and Nutritionist. I created Bulamu360 to make trusted nutrition guidance easier to access for individuals and families across Uganda.

My approach is simple: no shame, no fad diets, and no copy-paste meal plans. Your nutrition guidance should reflect your body, your health goals, your lifestyle, and the foods available to you.

Whether you are managing blood sugar, blood pressure, weight, digestion, energy, or family nutrition, Bulamu360 is here to help you take the next step with confidence.

How It Works

A Clearer Way to Understand Your Nutrition

A simple, guided path: we first understand your health, then help you choose the right level of nutrition support.

1

Start With Your Assessment

Share your body measurements, goals, routine, food access, health concerns, allergies, and preferences.

2

Receive a Clear Snapshot

Bulamu360 explains your starting point in plain language, without shame or confusing medical jargon.

3

Choose Your Support Level

Select Personal, Specialist, or Advanced support depending on how much guidance and review you need.

4

Verify and Unlock Your Guide

Submit your Mobile Money reference, wait for approval, then use your approval code to access your plan.

Free Assessment

Start With a Simple Health Assessment

Step 1 of 4Required details first

Your Personal Details

Start here: complete the required fields first. Optional clinical, lifestyle, and lab details are tucked below so the form feels lighter.

Optional details for a more precise plan
Special optional sections - open only what applies to you
🔬 Your Lab Results
Enter any results you have. Leave blank what you don't have. Breyer (RDN) will interpret each one and integrate findings into your plan.
🏅 Sports and Athletic Performance
Tell Breyer about your sport. This information is used to build your fuelling strategy, recovery nutrition, and timing recommendations around your training schedule.
🧠 Mental Health and Nutrition
What you eat significantly affects how you feel, think, and cope. Breyer (RDN) will incorporate foods that support brain chemistry, gut health, and stress management into your plan. All information is kept strictly confidential.
Nutrition for mental health works alongside (not instead of) professional mental health support. If you are in crisis, please reach out to a counsellor, trusted person, or your physician.
🧪 Food Micronutrient Checker
Type any food - local or international - to see its complete micronutrient breakdown. Data sourced from USDA FoodData Central and FAO/INFOODS. Works for virtually any food.
💫 Vitality and Hormonal Wellness
Hormonal balance, energy levels, and overall vitality are deeply connected to nutrition. This section helps Breyer (RDN) tailor your plan to support your hormonal health, energy, and physical wellbeing. Your responses are completely private and confidential.
All information is strictly confidential and used only to help Breyer personalise your nutritional plan. Hormonal and vitality issues are very commonly linked to nutritional deficiencies that are fully addressable through targeted dietary changes.
🔒 The Intimate Wellness section is only available to adults aged 18 and above. Please confirm your age in the Personal Details section above.
🌸 Intimate Wellness - For Adults 18 and Above
Everything you share here is completely private and confidential. This information helps Breyer (RDN) build a nutrition plan that directly supports your intimate health, physical energy, hormonal balance, and overall sexual wellbeing.
All responses are strictly confidential. Sexual and intimate health nutrition is a legitimate area of clinical dietetics with strong evidence supporting dietary interventions.
🤰 Pregnancy and Lactation Nutrition
Nutritional needs change significantly during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Breyer (RDN) will build a plan specifically calibrated for your stage, your baby's needs, and any special circumstances.
🌸 Women's Cycle-Based Nutrition
Your nutritional needs shift significantly across your menstrual cycle. Tell us where you are and Breyer will adjust your recommendations accordingly.
Your cycle phase significantly affects iron needs, magnesium requirements, carbohydrate tolerance, and mood. Breyer will tailor your plan to your current phase.
Your information is used to personalize your guidance. We treat health information with care and respect. Bulamu360 does not replace diagnosis, emergency care, medication, or your clinician's advice.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Bulamu360 is a personal nutrition guidance platform by Breyer Naula, RDN. It helps you understand your health, choose a suitable nutrition plan, and receive practical food guidance built around real life.
It is useful for people who want clearer guidance for weight goals, blood sugar, blood pressure, cholesterol, digestion, family meals, pregnancy support, sports nutrition, and everyday healthy eating.
No. The assessment gives a nutrition snapshot and practical next steps. It does not diagnose disease, prescribe medication, or replace your doctor, clinician, or emergency care.
Yes. Plans are designed around familiar foods such as matooke, beans, millet, sweet potatoes, greens, mukene, tilapia, groundnuts, fruits, and other practical local and global options.
Pricing depends on the support level you choose. The page shows Personal, Specialist, and Advanced options, with household support starting at three members.
After choosing a plan, select Airtel or MTN, send the exact amount to the displayed number, then submit the real transaction reference from your SMS. Your plan unlocks after review and approval.
Approval protects both the client and Bulamu360. It confirms the payment reference before the personalised guide, download link, or approval code is released.
Yes. Household support considers family size, ages, routines, food budget, preferences, health concerns, school or work meals, shared shopping lists, and age-appropriate portions.
Yes, but choose the Specialist Clinical Plan when a medical condition or life-stage concern needs deeper nutrition safety. Serious symptoms or medication changes should always be handled with your clinician.
No. Bulamu360 focuses on better portions, smarter swaps, preparation methods, balance, and consistency. The goal is progress you can live with, not shame or punishment.
Yes. Ask Bulamu Coach and the Meal Analyzer are part of the Advanced Nutrition Program. Once your Advanced payment is approved, these tools stay active for 35 days, then you can renew monthly for continued access.
Bulamu360 collects health information only to prepare your nutrition guidance and manage your order. Use the live secure link for customer submissions, not editable source files.
No. Blood group is not used to decide your diet. Guidance is based on nutrition science, goals, health conditions, medication context, labs where shared, allergies, budget, food access, and safety.
You can contact Breyer through the phone and WhatsApp details on the page if you need help with payment, approval codes, plan access, or choosing the right support level.
